# The word ORGANON as an Organon legibility fixture (PBR text, organon#217).
#
# Source: `native/assets/text/organon.txt` — the demo text the producer is fed, generated
# from a 5×7 pixel font at two cells per pixel (2:1 cell aspect → square pixels), with one
# blank row above and one below. Every cell is `█` or blank, so there is no half-block
# coverage and no `colours` block: the fixture is the shape alone, one colour. Census:
# 7 glyph rows × 82 columns = 574 cells, 9 × 82 = 738 with the two padding rows; lit 240
# (counted by `the_organon_fixture_is_the_demo_text_cell_for_cell` in tests/legibility.rs).
#
# The colour is the same Tokyo Night foreground `omarchy-logo.txt` uses, for the same
# reason — not pure white — and it is inert in the gate, which reads colours from the ring.
# Format: native/organon-render/src/legibility.rs, `Fixture::parse`.
grid v1
cols 82
rows 9
aspect 2
order top-down
default #c0caf5
glyphs
